name: PolicyComplianceForJobs
description:
The compliance APIs allow you to view and manage the policy compliance status of jobs
in your workspace. This API currently only supports compliance controls for cluster policies.

A job is in compliance if its cluster configurations satisfy the rules of all their respective
cluster policies. A job could be out of compliance if a cluster policy it uses was updated after
the job was last edited. The job is considered out of compliance if any of its clusters no longer
comply with their updated policies.

The get and list compliance APIs allow you to view the policy compliance status of a job.
The enforce compliance API allows you to update a job so that it becomes compliant with all of its policies.

methods.name: EnforceCompliance
methods.description:
Updates a job so the job clusters that are created when running
the job (specified in `new_cluster`) are compliant with the
current versions of their respective cluster policies.
All-purpose clusters used in the job will not be updated.

required_fields.name: job_id
required_fields.description: The ID of the job you want to enforce policy compliance on.

required_request_body_fields.name: job_id
required_request_body_fields.description: The ID of the job you want to enforce policy compliance on.

all_fields.name: job_id
all_fields.description: The ID of the job you want to enforce policy compliance on.

all_fields.name: validate_only
all_fields.description:
If set, previews changes made to the job to comply with its policy, but
does not update the job.

required_positional_arguments.name: job_id
required_positional_arguments.description: The ID of the job you want to enforce policy compliance on.

methods.name: GetCompliance
methods.description:
Returns the policy compliance status of a job. Jobs could be out of
compliance if a cluster policy they use was updated after the job was
last edited and some of its job clusters no longer comply with
their updated policies.

required_fields.name: job_id
required_fields.description: The ID of the job whose compliance status you are requesting.

required_in_url_fields.name: job_id
required_in_url_fields.description: The ID of the job whose compliance status you are requesting.

all_fields.name: job_id
all_fields.description: The ID of the job whose compliance status you are requesting.

required_positional_arguments.name: job_id
required_positional_arguments.description: The ID of the job whose compliance status you are requesting.

methods.name: ListCompliance
methods.description:
Returns the policy compliance status of all jobs that use a
given policy. Jobs could be out of compliance if a cluster policy they
use was updated after the job was last edited and its job
clusters no longer comply with the updated policy.

required_fields.name: policy_id
required_fields.description: Canonical unique identifier for the cluster policy.

required_in_url_fields.name: policy_id
required_in_url_fields.description: Canonical unique identifier for the cluster policy.

all_fields.name: page_size
all_fields.description:
Use this field to specify the maximum number of results to be returned by the server.
The server may further constrain the maximum number of results returned in a
single page.

all_fields.name: page_token
all_fields.description:
A page token that can be used to navigate to the next page or previous page as
returned by `next_page_token` or `prev_page_token`.

all_fields.name: policy_id
all_fields.description: Canonical unique identifier for the cluster policy.

required_positional_arguments.name: policy_id
required_positional_arguments.description: Canonical unique identifier for the cluster policy.
